name: audinowho/RogueElements
description: A game-agnostic roguelike map generation library using a modular pipeline of GenSteps, supporting room placement, BSP splitting, mazes, corridors, and content population. Designed to be engine-independent and fully customizable.
score_rationale: The most complete game-agnostic roguelike map generation library with a composable pipeline architecture.
summary: Engine-agnostic roguelike map generation library with modular GenStep pipeline architecture.
